title: New in the lab: digital image correlation and 3D scanning
summary: The group has added a digital image correlation (DIC) setup for full-field strain measurement and a 3D scanner for dimensional checks of printed parts.

title: Dr. Seid Ahmed receives The Best Emerging Coach Award at KFUPM
summary: Dr. Seid Ahmed received The Best Emerging Coach Award from King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals. The award was granted on May 2026 as a prize recognising her contribution as an emerging coach.It reflects her commitment to guiding and supporting others at KFUPM.

title: industry collaboration
summary: KFUPM and Aramco have signed a mutual NDA, led by Dr. Yassmin Seid Ahmed (Sustainable Polymer Manufacturing Group). This is an important step toward a proposed technical collaboration in polymer manufacturing, with technical discussions.

title: Mr. Osama (PhD student) wins second place at KFUPM “Lands of Islam” event
summary: Mr. Osama, a PhD student, won second place in the “Lands of Islam” event organized by KFUPM Student Affairs. The team received the second-place prize of 2,000 SAR. The achievement reflects the engagement of KFUPM graduate students in cultural and community activities beyond their research.

title: 3D Scanner Demonstration and Hands-On Training Session
summary:
The laboratory successfully conducted a 3D Scanner Demonstration and Hands-On Training Session on 25 November 2026 at 11:00 AM, led by Dr. Afzal. The session was attended by Postdoctoral Researchers and PhD students, providing participants with an opportunity to gain practical knowledge of advanced 3D scanning technology.

During the demonstration, Dr. Afzal introduced the key features, operating principles, and applications of the 3D scanner. The session highlighted how 3D scanning can be utilized for accurate geometry capture, reverse engineering, digital modeling, quality inspection, and research applications.

A major highlight of the event was the hands-on training component, where participants were given the opportunity to operate the scanner under expert guidance. Attendees learned the complete workflow, from data acquisition to the generation of high-quality digital models, allowing them to gain valuable practical experience with the equipment.

The interactive session encouraged discussion and knowledge exchange, helping researchers understand the capabilities of the technology and its potential applications in ongoing and future research projects. The training reflects the laboratory's commitment to enhancing technical expertise and promoting the adoption of advanced research tools among its researchers and students.
